lines.text: Players say there's a UFO in GTA 6. But only at night.
Head east of Port Gellhorn, to the Starlet Motel.
Find the clearing nearby. And wait until it gets dark.
One more thing. It reportedly only shows up from Chapter Two.
Nobody has fully confirmed it yet. So this case stays unverified.
If you've seen it, tell us what happened.
